items.source: The default predicate matches controller methods whose return type is not recognized by the configured ReactiveAdapterRegistry.
items.translation: 默认谓词匹配那些返回类型未被配置的 ReactiveAdapterRegistry 识别的控制器方法。

items.source:
By default, this is not set in which case controller methods are
invoked without the use of an Executor.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此值未设置，此时将不使用 Executor 调用控制器方法。

items.source: Configure a predicate to decide if a controller method is blocking and should be called on a separate thread if an executor is configured.
items.translation: 配置一个谓词，以决定是否将控制器方法视为阻塞操作，并且如果已配置了执行器executor，则应在单独的线程中调用该方法。

items.source: Helps to configure options related to blocking execution in WebFlux.
items.translation: 有助于配置与 WebFlux 中阻止执行相关的选项。

items.source: Configure an executor to invoke blocking controller methods with.
items.translation: 配置一个执行器，用于以...方式调用阻塞控制器方法。
